title_cn: 中东紧张局势持续，油价走高：市场结束
summary: Oil opened slightly higher as traders weighed renewed Israeli attacks on Lebanon and the prospect of fresh US sanctions on Iran ahead of the formal end of the ceasefire due Monday.

title: National Australia Bank Profit Edges Up on Business Bank Growth
title_cn: 澳大利亚国民银行利润因商业银行增长而小幅上升
summary: National Australia Bank Ltd.’s profit climbed in the third quarter as lending to businesses across the country expanded.

summary: “I have instructed Secretary of War, Pete Hegseth, to substantially reduce the Joint Military Exercises,” with South Korea, President Donald Trump says in a post on Truth Social.

title_cn: 必和必拓以有史以来最低的“买入”评级进入盈利阶段
summary: Analysts are less bullish on BHP Group Ltd. ahead of Tuesday’s full-year results, with buy recommendations for its Sydney-listed stock falling to a record low.

title: US 20-Year Bond Sale to Test Demand as Yield Curve Steepens
title_cn: 随着收益率曲线陡峭，美国20年期债券发行将测试需求
summary: The sale of 20-year government bonds this week will test investor appetite for long-term debt following a few record-breaking auctions.

title: Bloomberg This Weekend | Meta on Trial, the Race To Replace Gov. DeSantis, and Pet Longevity
title_cn: 彭博社本周末 |审判中的梅塔、取代德桑蒂斯州长的竞赛以及宠物的长寿
summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts Joe Mathieu, Carol Massar and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Rep. Byron Donalds (R- FL), Rob Bonta, California Attorney General, Vice Admiral Robert Hayward, Fmr. CENTCOM Deputy Commander, Jennifer Lee, BMO Capital Markets Senior Economist, Jen Gavito, Fmr. Deputy Asst. Secretary of State,  Ben Wikler, Author of “This is the Plan”, and Olivia Ferney, Luxury Travel & Event Expert. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed’s Internal Rate Debate Faces New Scrutiny
title_cn: 美联储内部利率辩论面临新的审查
summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve’s July meeting will offer a closer look at the debate that produced three dissents in favor of a quarter-point rate increase, an unusually visible split as policymakers contend with elevated inflation and mixed economic data. Joining Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend, BMO Capital Markets Senior Economist Jennifer Lee expects the Fed to remain patient, with the firm forecasting no rate move until late 2027, when it expects the central bank to begin cutting. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Inside the Business of Ultra Luxury Travel
title_cn: 超豪华旅游业务内部
summary: Luxury Travel and Event Expert Olivia Ferney sits down with Lisa Mateo, Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend and shares how she has built a business catering to ultrawealthy clients whose requests can range from six-figure vacations to elaborate celebrations, while creating a social media following of more than 1 million. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Donalds Looks to Build on DeSantis Legacy
title_cn: 唐纳德希望继承德桑蒂斯的遗产
summary: Republican Rep. Byron Donalds is on Bloomberg This Weekend and tells hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar that affordability will be central to his campaign for Florida governor, proposing changes aimed at property taxes, insurance, housing and health-care costs while promising to build on Gov. Ron DeSantis’ record. Donalds, who holds a wide polling lead ahead of Tuesday’s Republican primary, also defended President Donald Trump’s approach to Iran despite higher gasoline prices and said he expects to earn DeSantis’ support if he advances to the general election. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Beef Prices Stay High as US Cattle Supply Shrinks
title_cn: 由于美国牛肉供应减少，牛肉价格居高不下
summary: Tyson Foods is cutting beef-processing capacity as the US cattle herd nears a five-decade low driving up livestock costs and contributing to persistent losses in beef business. Bloomberg News Agriculture Reporter Ilena Peng is on Bloomberg This Weekend and explains to hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar that consumers are also pushing back against record prices, but meaningful relief may take years as the herd rebuilds, while a planned resumption of some cattle imports from Mexico could provide limited near-term help. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stock-Market Calm Masks Fast Shifting Investor Sentiment
title_cn: 股市平静掩盖了快速变化的投资者情绪
summary: While the recent equity-market turbulence is subsiding, options positioning shows how quickly investor sentiment can switch between the extremes of fear and greed.

title: Longevity Boom Reaches America’s Pets
title_cn: 美国宠物的长寿热潮
summary: Pet owners are increasingly extending the longevity treatments humans pursue for themselves to their dogs, experimenting with supplements, red light therapy and drugs including rapamycin even as veterinarians urge caution about unproven treatments. Bloomberg News National Heath Care Reporter Anna Edney is on Bloomberg This Weekend and explains to hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar that US pet spending is projected to reach $165 billion in 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Perfection Fuels a Return to Looking Human
title_cn: 人工智能的完美推动人类回归
summary: Bloomberg Businessweek Senior Reporter Amanda Mull says consumers are showing signs of fatigue with the polished faces, homes and lifestyles popularized by influencers, filters and increasingly AI-generated imagery. Mull tells Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend that the shift doesn’t necessarily spell the end of Botox or other cosmetic treatments, but it may favor a more natural aesthetic as people seek individuality, physical media and experiences that feel less optimized for social media. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Iran Pressure Campaign Lacks Clear Off Ramp
title_cn: 伊朗施压行动缺乏明确的出路
summary: Acting Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary for the Bureau of Near Eastern Affairs Jen Gavito and retired Vice Adm. Robert Harward join Bloomberg This Weekend and offer sharply different assessments of whether escalating US economic pressure can change Iran’s calculus, with Gavito arguing sanctions alone are unlikely to provide an off ramp and Harward saying they can weaken Tehran when combined with political and military pressure. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: By The Way: Headline Roundup
title_cn: 顺便说一下：标题综述
summary: Marathon wine, wedding party size, suit sales rise and Gen Z's different wealth plan: Bloomberg News' Lisa Mateo joins Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend to share headlines you may have missed from over the week. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Crowded Florida Race Puts Trump’s Clout to Test
title_cn: 拥挤的佛罗里达州竞选考验特朗普的影响力
summary: Florida’s 19th Congressional District has drawn a crowded Republican field seeking to replace Byron Donalds, who is running for governor, with former Trump administration official Catalina Lauf gaining a potentially significant boost from the president’s endorsement. Bloomberg News Government Senior Reporter Greg Giroux is on Bloomberg This Weekend to explain that the race comes as affordability, insurance costs and concerns about data centers emerge as campaign issues across Florida ahead of Tuesday’s primary. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: At AI-Fueled Market Party, Wall Street Eyes the Rates Punch Bowl
title_cn: 在人工智能推动的市场派对上，华尔街关注利率潘趣酒
summary: Enthusiasm for Big Tech and its huge investments in artificial intelligence is powering the stock market to record highs again. With a resilient economy and scorching demand, there’s seemingly only one obstacle that can derail this ride: higher interest rates.

title: Traders Get Pickier After Big Run in $886 Billion EM Debt Market
title_cn: 8860 亿美元新兴市场债务市场大幅上涨后，交易员变得更加挑剔
summary: Persistent inflation worries and currency swings are pushing emerging-market investors to adjust bets in an $886 billion asset class that’s been delivering outsize returns for more than a year.

title: What’s Happening in EM: Traders Get Pickier on Linkers (Podcast)
title_cn: 新兴市场正在发生什么：交易者对链接器变得更加挑剔（播客）
summary: Bogota-based EM reporter Nicolle Yapur joins Leda Alvim to discuss why investors are looking beyond Brazil and Mexico for opportunities in inflation-linked bonds in the emerging world.

title: Iran MOU Expires With Diplomacy Still in Play
title_cn: 伊朗谅解备忘录到期，外交仍在进行中
summary: Bloomberg News Middle East Reporter Dan Williams is on Bloomberg This Weekend discussing how the expiration of the US-Iran memorandum of understanding is unlikely by itself to trigger a return to all-out fighting, with diplomatic efforts over the Strait of Hormuz continuing despite repeated attacks on commercial vessels. Williams explains to hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar that the Trump administration is increasingly emphasizing economic pressure on Tehran as hopes for a broader settlement remain elusive and Israel assesses whether sanctions could force Iran toward concessions. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Stripe Inc. has finalized an agreement to acquire OpenRouter Inc., a startup that helps companies switch between artificial intelligence models, for more than $7 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Skyrocketing Beef Prices Finally Have Americans Reaching Their Spending Limit
title_cn: 牛肉价格飙升最终让美国人达到了消费极限
summary: Aaron Kaufman used to meet his lofty daily protein goals — a gram for each pound he weighs — with ground beef.

title: Alex Cooper Leaves Long-Time Agent, Seeking New Help to Build Media Empire
title_cn: 亚历克斯·库珀离开长期经纪人，寻求新的帮助来建立媒体帝国
summary: Alex Cooper is leaving her long-time talent agent for CAA after raising money to expand her business

title: Bonta Says Meta Put Profit Over Children’s Safety
title_cn: Bonta 表示 Meta 将利润置于儿童安全之上
summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta joins Bloomberg This Weekend and calls the landmark youth safety case against Meta a “tobacco moment,” alleging the company knowingly designed Facebook and Instagram features that harmed children and put profit ahead of their safety. Bonta tells hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar the states are seeking financial penalties as well as changes to Meta’s products, while the company denies the allegations and says it has worked to make its platforms safer for young people. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Faces Landmark Trial Over Youth Harm Claims
title_cn: Meta 因青少年伤害索赔面临里程碑式的审判
summary: Meta faces a landmark federal trial brought by 29 states over allegations that Facebook and Instagram were deliberately designed to addict young users and that the company improperly collected children’s data. Bloomberg News Tech Reporter Alexandra Levine joins Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend to explain that the case could expose Meta to substantial penalties and potentially more consequential court-ordered changes to how its platforms operate. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Says He’s Curtailing Military Drills With South Korea
title_cn: 特朗普表示他将减少与韩国的军事演习
summary: President Donald Trump said he told the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” joint military exercises with South Korea and suggested his shift was driven by frustration that the longtime US ally hadn’t provided more support for his war with Iran.

title: Zambian President Hichilema Extends Lead in Reelection Bid
title_cn: 赞比亚总统希奇莱马在连任竞选中扩大领先优势
summary: Zambia’s president widened his lead among voters with over half of electoral constituencies counted, moving closer to extending his rule over the copper-rich southern African nation for a second term.

title: Israel Strikes Lebanon as US Prepares Fresh Iran Sanctions
title_cn: 美国准备对伊朗实施新制裁，以色列袭击黎巴嫩
summary: Lebanon saw its deadliest day of fighting in months, heaping pressure on stalled US-Iran negotiations while Washington preps fresh sanctions.

title: Blanche Defends Reflecting Pool Prosecutor Who Angered Trump
title_cn: 布兰奇为激怒特朗普的反思池检察官辩护
summary: US Attorney General Todd Blanche defended Jeanine Pirro for dismissing a federal vandalism case in a decision that angered President Donald Trump, saying the top prosecutor in Washington, DC, should be judged fairly.

title: Lecornu Plans Crisis Meeting on Cyberattack at French Tax Agency
title_cn: 勒科尔努计划在法国税务局召开网络攻击危机会议
summary: French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu will hold a crisis meeting Monday to respond to the cyberattack disclosed last week targeting the country’s tax collection agency.

title: Wisconsin Turnout Fuels Democrats’ Midterm Hopes
title_cn: 威斯康星州的投票率点燃了民主党的中期希望
summary: Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Former Wisconsin Democratic Party Chair Ben Wikler tells hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar that David Crowley’s narrow gubernatorial primary victory and unusually strong Democratic turnout show voters are focused on affordability and eager for political change ahead of November. Crowley now faces Republican Rep. Tom Tiffany in one of the country’s most closely watched governor’s races, while Democrats test whether elevated primary participation can translate into broader midterm gains. Wisconsin Democrats cast nearly 800,000 primary ballots, their highest midterm-primary total in more than two decades. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Is Cuba Finally Ready for Capitalism?
title_cn: 古巴终于准备好迎接资本主义了吗？
summary: Cuba’s economy is under severe pressure from tightening US sanctions, shrinking tourism and the loss of past economic lifelines from the Soviet Union and Venezuela. Cuban lawmakers have passed 176 free-market reforms aimed at expanding foreign and private investment, decentralizing the economy and liberalizing sectors including tourism, banking, property and agriculture. But economists and Cuban-American investors say Havana faces a credibility problem: the government has promised reform before, and it remains unclear whether it will truly reduce state control or simply buy time. Tourism could be an early opportunity if sanctions ease, but investors say Cuba will need legal, political and institutional change before capital returns at scale. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Second Ceuta Incursion Attempt Fails as Morocco, Spain Boost Security
title_cn: 摩洛哥和西班牙加强安全，第二次入侵休达的尝试失败
summary: Grassroots calls for a second incursion into Ceuta from Morocco fell flat over the weekend, with security tight and authorities turning back the relative handful who tried to make the move.

title: Nigerian Ruling Party Loses State Election Before National Polls
title_cn: 尼日利亚执政党在全国大选前输掉州选举
summary: A governor in Nigeria’s southwestern Osun state fended off a challenge from the ruling party to secure another four-year term, giving the fractured opposition a morale-boosting victory ahead of national elections in January.

title: Wildberries Depot Ablaze Near Moscow as Drone Downed in Romania
title_cn: 无人机在罗马尼亚被击落，莫斯科附近的野莓仓库起火
summary: A Wildberries warehouse near Moscow caught fire after a Ukrainian drone strike, the regional governor said, part of one of the largest recent attacks on the broader capital area.
